geometry_edits: Rebuilt the structural wall shell from the official source polygon while preserving the asset object, collection, scene, ID and file path.
Replaced the flat roof cap with sloped roof planes and a smaller raised inner ridge surface; roof plan, spans and rise are approximate because the archive photo is unmeasured.
Added an archive-photo-informed entrance gable, three smaller gabled dormers and two raised chimneys; exact placement and dimensions are estimates.
Added repeated brick-and-limestone window surrounds with divided-light muntins consistent with the documented Tudor/limestone vocabulary.
Added shallow projecting bay windows at selected positions on the principal facade, based on visible stacked bays in the 2004 archive image.
Added a limestone entrance portal and a schematic low-relief lion-and-shield motif based on the Purdue Archives description.
Moved the schematic entrance marker and lion-and-shield relief beneath the large front-facing gable; entry location and relief dimensions remain approximate.
uncertainties: The official campus map polygon is not a certified survey and has no published positional or dimensional uncertainty.
The 15.2 m height remains an estimate; the GIS level count is not a measured height.

The archive describes Tudor design, brick and Indiana limestone, and the lion-and-shield feature; its 2004 photo supports broad roof and facade form but is not a measured elevation or georeferenced source.
The 20.4 m mesh peak includes approximate roof, gable and chimney geometry; overall elevation, roof plan, entrance position, facade bay rhythm, divided-light pattern and lion relief remain estimates.

The 2026-10-26 independent grade passed at 8.2/10; master-blend integration remains pending. Roof silhouette, gable geometry, bay dimensions, portal, relief and absolute building height remain approximate.
